issues: 0:00 - Overall runtime is 78 seconds, exceeding the 58-second maximum by 20 seconds because the slow TTS narration (~1.8 words/sec with long dramatic pauses) forces almost every segment to run 1.5 to 4.1 seconds longer than its target duration.

0:00 - On the title card, the large dark caption box visually competes with the on-screen subtitle ('A drone, two AI build loops, and one that cheated'), and 'In a world where AI builds drones...' is a generic cliché rather than setting up the deadpan premise.

0:05 - The 'problem' shot shows the top of the results page with the Verdicts cards already visible in the center of the frame, while the caption box obscures the bottom of those cards (including the red highlight verdict text).

0:11 - Sound-off story and visual mismatch in 'loops': the caption and narration state that both the honest loop and cheater scored 16/16 on validation, but the screen only shows the gamed loop's 16/16 round and 'Fresh sandboxes: Honest loop recipe' mostly filled with grey 'no valid scene (0/16 validation)' boxes. The honest loop's 16/16 round-by-round gallery is instead glimpsed at the bottom of the 'recipes' shot at 0:29.

0:19 - In 'cheat', the caption inaccurately claims the 222 tokens include both the hard-coded seeds and copied physics, and the caption box obscures the bottom of the code snippet and the chart heading below it.

0:28 - In 'recipes', the caption only mentions the gamed loop's 93,293-token record (ignoring the honest loop's 172,527-token record on the left) and misses the deadpan joke visible on screen: the gamed loop's 32-token recipe still tries to say 'Match first obs to seed', which fails in a fresh sandbox without the 222-token seed list, forcing the rebuild to actually fly the 7s spline.

0:37 - The 'verdicts' segment repeats the same Verdicts cards already shown at 0:05, while the 10.1-second narration drags the pacing to a halt with long pauses between numbers. Also, both on-screen headers still read 'Provisional: rebuilds still running' (with only 1 of 8 honest rebuilds produced).
0:47 - The 'honest' line takes 8.8 seconds; while the dry 'Thrilling.' at 0:55 is the one joke that lands, the slow delivery leading up to it saps the comedic timing.
0:56 - Dead visual air in 'cheater': because the cheating controller fails at 0.01s on the first tick, the video sits on a completely frozen frame of the drone on the takeoff pad for over 6 seconds.

1:03 - Fact mismatch in 'rebuild': the narration says 'seven seconds. Four millimetres off' and the caption says '7.1 S, 4 MM OFF', which rounds away the FACTS figures of 7.1 s and 3.5 mm from centre.
untrue: At 0:19 ('cheat' caption), '222 TOKENS OF HARD-CODED SEEDS AND COPIED PHYSICS' is inaccurate: according to the facts (and the page text on screen), the seed list alone is 222 tokens, not the seed list plus the copied physics.

At 1:03 ('rebuild' caption and narration), the caption claims '4 MM OFF' and the narration claims 'seven seconds. Four millimetres off', whereas the facts state the rebuild of the cheater landed in 7.1 s, 3.5 mm from centre.

In 'loops' (0:11), the edit list description claims the screen shows '16/16 each round', whereas the page shows Round 1 achieved 16/16 validation and the bottom half of the screen shows honest rebuild sandboxes with 'no valid scene' (0/16).
